## Buying guide

Choose TPE for softness and a lower price, or silicone for tear resistance and easier cleaning. Choose a full-size doll for realism and posing, or a torso for lower weight and simpler storage. Weight is the spec most buyers underestimate: a 39.6 lb model needs a stable surface and a storage plan, while a 17.4 lb model is much easier to live with. Clean after every use, dry completely, lightly powder TPE, and store in a breathable cover away from heat and dark fabrics. Quzio ships in plain packaging with a neutral sender name and confidential billing.

## Community buying questions

### Which Quzio full-size doll is the best value under $600?

The Aline 157cm is listed at $499.99 and combines a full-size TPE body, articulated metal skeleton, internal heating and a three-channel design. It is the value-oriented choice when softness and price matter more than face styling.

### Aline 157cm or Elara 158cm?

Aline is currently $499.99 and Elara is $553.60. The price difference buys a different face and presentation, not a larger size class. Choose Aline for budget and softness, or Elara when its red-haired, blue-eyed styling is worth the premium.

### Whitney, Liana or Cora: which torso is easier to handle?

Whitney is listed at 17.4 lb, Liana at about 28.7 lb and Cora at about 39.6 lb. Buyers with limited storage or a one-person handling routine should start their comparison with Whitney. Liana adds 1:1 silicone scale and a bundled care kit, while Cora prioritises maximum stable weight and presence.

### What is included with the Liana 1:1 torso?

The current Quzio listing describes an automatic rinser, UV sterilization wand, absorbent sticks, suction tube, charging cable and manual. The bundle reduces the number of separate accessories to buy, but it does not remove the need to dry every surface, inspect seams and store the product in a breathable covering.

### Do internal heating and a gel-filled chest matter?

They can improve comfort and presentation, but should be checked against the selected selling plan. Aline, Elara and Cora currently mention internal heating; Aline and Cora also mention a gel-filled chest. Confirm the included accessory, heat duration and delivery-country safety requirements before relying on a feature.

## Methodology

Each product is scored on five weighted criteria: material disclosure (15%), build and durability (20%), cleaning and upkeep (20%), real-world experience (30%), and support and value (15%). Brand claims, platform tests and user feedback stay in separate fields. Findings apply only to the named model. Brands may correct facts or respond, but cannot buy scores or remove criticism.
